Consjitution of Committee for Cluster
Facilitation Proiect (CFP) under MGNREGS
(Guiarat State).
" 
Government of Gujarat
Panchayats, Rural Housing & Rural Development Department
Corrigendum No.NR G I l0 12020 I | 61 17 3 lKHz
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar
Date:01/0712020
READ:
1. Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department, Sachivalay, Gandhinagar's Resolution
N o. N RG / 1 0/ 2o2o I 1.6 1,17 3 / KH2, Dt : 2 0-0 3 - 2 0 2 0
2. The meeting minutes of the Cluster Facilitation Project (CFP) committee held on Dt:17-06-2020 at
Commissionerate Rural Development, Gandhinagar.
PREAMBLE :
ln view of the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of lndia, New Delhi's Letter DO #
1,101,4/111,12018-RE(lV) (362818) , Dt:08/01/2020 & Cluster Facilitation Project (CFP) Guidelines, rhe
Government of Gujarat has constituted the Committee for Cluster Facilitation Project (CFP) under MGNREGS
(Gujarat State) read at Sr. No.(1). The meeting of the Cluster Facilitation Project (CFP) committee held on
dated 17-06-2020 chaired by the Commissioner & Secretary (RDD) and Chairperson State Level CFP
Committee (Gujarat State) and suggested that the Chairman of the State LevelCFP committee shall be the
Principal Secretary / Secretary & Commissioner (RDD) Panchayats, Rural Housing & Rural Development
Department in the state read at Sr. No.(2). As suggested in the minutes of meeting, the Commissionerate
Rural Development presented the proposal and requested to make necessary amendments in the State Level
CFP Committee Resolution read at Sr. No.(1). The matter was under consideration of the Government of
Gujarat for some time past.
CORRIGENDUM:
After careful consideration, the Government of Gujarat is hereby pleased to amend the below part of
the resolution of the Cluster Facilitation Project (CFP) committee under MGNREGS (Gujarat State) read at Sr.
No. (1).
1. i Principalsecretary/ Secretary & Commissioner (RDD)- Panchayats, Rural ] 
Chairman
Housing & Rural Development Department, Government of Gujarat
2. All the other terms and conditions stipulated in the Government Resolution dated 20-03-2020 mentioned
at above Sr. No. (1)will remain unchanged.
D:Mnrcga-20 I 7/Resolution-20 I 8
